title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at Quantum eMotion, Qtonic Quantum, Chicago Quantum Exchange, and Equal1 - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Executive appointments: Wayne Teeple becomes CTO of Quantum eMotion amid its proposed Plurilock acquisition; retired Lt. Gen. Roger Cloutier Jr. leads operations at Qtonic Quantum as federal PQC migration mandates under Executive Order 14412 take effect; Aaron Fluitt becomes CEO of Chicago Quantum Exchange; and Andrew Flynn joins Equal1 as COO to scale its RacQ rack-mounted quantum computer.

insights.claim: Quantum eMotion appointed board member Wayne Teeple as CTO to lead technology strategy across its QRNG, SecureKey, Sentry-Q and eShield-Q platforms and oversee technical alignment for its proposed acquisition of Plurilock Security Inc.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Signals QeM is preparing to integrate Plurilock, a consolidation move in quantum security.

insights.claim: Qtonic Quantum appointed retired Lt. Gen. Roger L. Cloutier Jr., former commander of NATO Allied Land Command, to lead operations as federal migration mandates take effect under Executive Order 14412.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Federal PQC migration mandates are a demand catalyst for cryptographic discovery vendors.
insights.quote: He will oversee operational execution and organizational scale as federal migration mandates take effect under Executive Order 14412

insights.claim: Qtonic is stacking its leadership with retired general officers (Mark Weatherington, Milford Beagle Jr., Shan Bagby) to deploy its QScout and QSolve cryptographic discovery and migration platforms.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Defense-heavy leadership suggests a government and defense go-to-market focus.

insights.claim: Chicago Quantum Exchange named Aaron Fluitt, formerly Senior Director for Technology Partnerships at PsiQuantum, as its second CEO succeeding Kate Timmerman, to expand the Midwest quantum workforce and manufacturing supply chain via the Bloch Quantum Tech Hub.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Supply-chain focus at a regional hub points to US efforts to domesticate quantum manufacturing.

insights.claim: Fluitt helped lead Argonne National Laboratory's initiative that established the $115 million DOE Q-NEXT quantum research center.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem

insights.claim: Equal1 hired semiconductor executive Andrew Flynn (ex-Qorvo, Decawave, Xilinx) as COO to oversee operations, quality systems and supply chain scaling as it accelerates commercialization of its RacQ rack-mounted quantum computer.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hiring semiconductor operations talent indicates Equal1 is moving toward manufacturing-scale production.
